 By The Associated Press , Special to The Daily Memphian Published: October 25, 2026 10:42 PM CT Memphis Grizzlies forward Cedric Coward (23), center, maneuvers between Sacramento Kings guard Daeqwon Plowden (29) and guard Malik Monk (0) as he drives to the basket during the first half of an NBA basketball game, Sunday, Oct. 25, 2026, in Sacramento, California. (Jose Luis Villegas/AP)
 The Memphis Grizzlies faced the Sacramento Kings at Golden 1 Center on Sunday, Oct. 25.
